description: A non-ARQ U_PDU to the broadcast address from a node with a one-nibble address goes out with address size 7, the smallest that holds the broadcast destination.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 0 it sends an S_UNIDATA_REQUEST: priority 0, SAP 5 at 31.255.255.255, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0 (TTD 1296000000 ms, A-0089, A-0091), U_PDU "hello", no confirmation, so no SIS output (A-0095). This node's own address is 0.0.0.7, which alone needs one nibble. There is no address size setting: the sender picks, per D_PDU, the smallest whole number of nibbles that holds both the destination and the source, and m is that number (C-0133, C-0130); leading zero nibbles are dropped and trailing ones kept (C-0131). The destination is the broadcast address 31.255.255.255 (C-0123): GROUP ADDRESS 1 (C-0122, C-0338, C-0339) and the 28-bit destination 15.255.255.255, which needs all seven nibbles, so m = 7. With m odd the middle address byte is shared (C-0117): the field is ff ff ff f0 00 00 07, destination in the first three and a half bytes and source 0.0.0.7 in the last three and a half (C-0115, C-0116, C-0127). The D_PDU is type 7 (C-0323, C-0575), EOW 0 EMPTY (C-0398), C_PDU ID 0, offset 0, the whole 11-byte DATA C_PDU (DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 5 with its TTD, B-0297) as its one segment, 39 bytes in all, in block 0 of a one-block burst (256-byte blocks, preamble 600, flush 150, duration 5550 ms), so EOT and reception window ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-0350, C-1043). Contention: LBT 30000 (DCD-determined idle, K-0070), slot 15 from seed 0, 45000 ms (K-0080). This case was added for issue M0LTE/M0LTE.S5066#35, where a fixed configured address size could not hold the destination.
